statusCalls.explanation: Worker welcome turn queried before captain created t1; returned zero tasks and that observation became stale.
Captain checked after the worker sent a native ready message based on the earlier zero-task snapshot.
Captain checked after receiving the AgentTeams completion report.
Worker checked after completion when a previously queued captain reminder was delivered.

wakeup.interpretation: Normal end-to-end completion and notification consumption are proven. The first observed idle/wake pair belongs to the native ready message. A later actual AgentTeams completion message was consumed, but native notifications coexist and the observer did not record a second idle transition; use the separately verified deterministic fixture for isolated notification causality.

extraRequestSources: Worker welcome-turn status snapshot preceded task creation; its later native idle/ready message used that stale zero-task observation.
Captain reacted by checking status and sending an extra task reminder while the automatic assignment was already executing.
Worker reported through both AgentTeams and native send_message.
The queued captain reminder reached the worker after task completion, producing one further status check and a no-op completion acknowledgement.

answerIndependence.interpretation: The harness task lifecycle is validated; this run is not a blind independent-reasoning benchmark.
